note: SAMPLE data, not an observation of a running Agent Server. Each record stands in for the OpenHands Agent Server's conversation info (GET /api/conversations/{id}) and carries only fields that F-04.2 recorded (evidence/F-04.2-conversation-lifecycle.md, section 4.2): id, title, tags, created_at and workspace. The ids are the integration store's reserved conversation ids (uuid5 of the operation keys work-TASK-1/implement/revision-1 and work-TASK-2/implement/revision-1); the values are samples.
